mapper.select: SELECT id, account_reference, cash_balance, buying_power, status, version, last_updated FROM accounts WHERE id = #{accountId}
SELECT CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name) FROM users WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT account_id, symbol, qty, avg_cost FROM positions WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND qty <> 0 ORDER BY symbol ASC
SELECT id, account_reference, cash_balance, buying_power, status, version, last_updated FROM accounts WHERE account_reference = #{accountReference}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cash_balance), 0) AS total_money, COUNT(*) AS total_accounts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS open_accounts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUSPENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS suspended_accounts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS closed_accounts FROM accounts
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts a WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.account_id = a.id )

SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_reference, a.cash_balance, a.buying_power, a.status, a.last_updated, u.username AS assigned_username, CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_unassigned FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.account_id = a.id WHERE u.id IS NULL OR a.status IN ('SUSPENDED', 'CLOSED') ORDER BY (CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET status = #{status}, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounts ( account_reference, cash_balance, buying_power, status, version, last_updated ) VALUES ( #{accountReference}, #{cashBalance}, #{buyingPower}, #{status}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE accounts SET cash_balance = cash_balance + #{amount}, buying_power = buying_power + #{amount}, version = version + 1, last_updated = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO balance_history ( account_id, type, amount, related_order_id ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{type}, #{amount}, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT account_reference FROM accounts WHERE account_reference ~ '^ETP-220[0-9]+$' ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(account_reference FROM 8) AS BIGINT) DESC LIMIT 1
